summary.what_it_does: This is the articles index page of Anthropic's Claude blog, showing a list of recent posts (11 of 299 resources shown). The listed posts cover product launches and vertical offerings such as Claude for Legal, Claude for Financial Advisors, and Claude for Nonprofits, plus enterprise topics like Claude Enterprise and Claude Cowork with chat. Engineering posts include guidance on when to replace subagents with progressively disclosed context and tools in Claude Platform, and a Claude Code cost and ROI guide for Google Cloud. A post on LLMs and formal software verification also appears.
notable: Index of 299 Anthropic articles, with a featured resource carousel
Covers vertical offerings for legal, financial advisors, and nonprofits
Engineering guidance on subagents versus progressively disclosed context in Claude Platform
Listed in awesome-claude-code under 'From Anthropic' for the Steering Claude Code extension framework
caveats: This is a listing page, not a single tool; individual posts must be opened for details
Page text does not state pricing for the products mentioned
